name: Aryabhata
description: Bharat ka pehla upagrah (satellite) jise Soviet Union ke rocket ki madad se kamyabi se launch kiya gaya tha.

name: Chandrayaan-1
description: Bharat ka pehla Moon Orbiter mission, jisne chandrama par pani ke anuan (Water Molecules) ki aitihasik khoj ki thi.

name: Mangalyaan (MOM)
description: Apne pehle hi prayas mein Mars (Mangal) ki kaksha mein pahunchkar ISRO ne duniya mein naya kirtiman banaya.

name: AstroSat
description: Bharat ki pehli dedicated multi-wavelength space observatory jo black holes aur cosmic X-ray sources ka adhyayan karti hai.

name: PSLV-C37
description: Ek hi PSLV rocket se ek saath 104 satellites ko space mein bhejkar ISRO ne tab ka sabse bada world record banaya tha.

name: Chandrayaan-2
description: Is mission ka lander crash ho gaya tha, lekin iska Orbiter aaj bhi chandrama ki bilkul sateek tasveerein bhej raha hai.

name: Chandrayaan-3
description: Chandrama ke Dakhshini Dhruv (South Pole) par soft-landing karne wala Bharat duniya ka sabse pehla desh bana.

name: Aditya-L1
description: Surya ka adhyayan karne wala Bharat ka pehla mission, jo Lagrange Point 1 (L1) par sthit rehkar data bhej raha hai.

name: XPoSat
description: Black holes aur neutron stars se nikalne wali X-rays ka polarimetry study karne wala duniya ka dusra dedicated mission.

name: SpaDeX
description: Space mein do alag-alag satellites ko aapas mein jodne (docking) ki technology ka parikshan, jo Indian Space Station ke liye zaroori hai.

name: Axiom Mission 4 (Ax-4)
description: ISRO ke astronaut Shubhanshu Shukla ne is mission ke zariye International Space Station (ISS) par kamyabi se samay bitaya.

name: NISAR
description: NASA aur ISRO ka joint radar imaging mission, jo poori prithvi ki sateeh halchal aur climate change par nazar rakhta hai.

name: GSLV-F17 / EOS-05
description: 4 September 2026 ko kamyabi se launch kiya gaya advanced weather satellite, jo cyclone aur disaster management mein madad karta hai.

name: Gaganyaan-1 (G1)
description: Bharat ke pehle manav-yukt mission ka pehla bina insaan wala test flight, jisme 'Vyommitra' humanoid robot ko bheja jayega.

name: Chandrayaan-4
description: Chandrama ki satah se mitti aur pattharon ke samples ko wapas dharti (Earth) par surakshit lekar aane wala agla bada mission.
